evidence_notes: GitHub release metadata shows rust-v0.140.0-alpha.4 was published at 2026-06-10T19:46:17Z with only a sparse release body: Release 0.140.0-alpha.4.

GitHub release metadata has no release object for rust-v0.140.0-alpha.3 in this run's readback, although the Git tag exists; this record treats rust-v0.140.0-alpha.4 as the next public prerelease release checkpoint after rust-v0.140.0-alpha.2.
The correct public prerelease comparison for this checkpoint is rust-v0.140.0-alpha.2 -> rust-v0.140.0-alpha.4; GitHub compare metadata reports 27 ahead commits.

PR-title metadata in the alpha.2 -> alpha.4 compare points to plugin identity and hosted plugin runtime, provider-default memory models, app-server realtime/background-terminal/delete APIs, MCP startup and manager behavior, goal analytics, thread-list and rollout performance, ToolExecutor refactors, SQLite recovery, and release build tooling.

Checked Radar review/impact artifacts cover only part of the alpha.4 window: #26701, #27129, #27174, #27198, and #27383 have review and impact records, while #27375 has review without a matching upstream_impact/v1 record in this checkout.
The refreshed checked release_delta/v1 records stable rust-v0.139.0 -> latest prerelease rust-v0.140.0-alpha.4 with 54 ahead commits and no tracked signal slugs.

Official Codex changelog readback for this run shows Codex app 26.608 and ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.153 on 2026-06-09; rust-v0.140.0-alpha.4 is a GitHub prerelease checkpoint, not an official changelog entry.
